|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Desperate Counter (V)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-133-Desperate_Counter-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 7.4 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Desperate Counter (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Desperate Counter (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011): “Unless Imperial Propaganda on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent’s control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may ▲ any one card. [Immune to Control] OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack a just-played Interrupt here.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 16 December 2011"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 24) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Desperate Counter (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) added “immediately” (“opponent may immediately ▲ any one card”), put a full stop after the Immune to Control icon and changed “stack a just-played Interrupt” to “stack one just-played interrupt” (the card list writes the ▲ icon as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”): “Unless Imperial Propaganda on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may immediately ▲ any one card. [Immune to Control]. OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack one just-played interrupt here.”.<ref name="cl-1274_5-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
